# enable golang, git, kubectl for zsh

Enable the Oh My Zsh plugins for the tools the author uses daily — `golang`, `git`, `kubectl` — to get their aliases and completions in zsh.

<!-- 2026-09-17T08:42Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/114#issuecomment-5711679511
Partly superseded: `a732d78` (fix #877) removed the `kubectl` and `docker` plugins. They regenerated their completion file in the background on every shell start, writing a temporary file into a directory on `fpath`, which raced `compinit` when several shells started at once. The list is now `plugins=(common-aliases docker-compose git golang)`, and the `kubectl`/`docker` completions come from Homebrew's `share/zsh/site-functions` instead. The `golang` and `git` halves of this ticket are unaffected.
-->
